MLH Fall Hackathon 2026: the winners

More than 600 hackers from 40 countries built projects over the weekend, and twelve judges from industry and academia scored the 154 submissions.

Alex Rivera won the Grand Prize for RoboGrasp Live, a low-cost grasping demo that ran on a $300 arm. The judges praised its reproducibility.

The Best Use of Data award went to a team from Lisbon for a flood-forecasting dashboard. Congratulations to everyone who took part.
